games.name: Terraria 3D
games.description: A walk-anywhere 3D recreation of Terraria. Requires your own Terraria copy (Steam). Multiplayer with friends.
games.notes:
Play with me:
1. Install Tailscale (free): https://tailscale.com/download and sign in. Accept the share link I send you.
2. In Terraria 3D: Multiplayer > type my 100.x.x.x Tailscale address in "Server address" > Join.
No Tailscale? I can forward UDP port 7777 instead; then join my public address.
We need the same version: update here when PackSync says there's a new one. Full steps: README.txt in the game folder, under "Play with a friend".
